missions.name: P1: Sales follow-up
missions.brief: Sales wants a short, high-quality list to call this week. Aim for 50 to 500 contacts, and include a behavior that shows buying intent.
missions.needMsg: The size is right, but a sales list needs an intent signal. Add a behavior such as a pricing page visit or a demo request.

missions.name: P2: Nurture campaign
missions.brief: Marketing wants a core audience for an automated nurture series. Aim for 500 to 5,000 contacts, and use job titles so the content can speak to a persona.
missions.needMsg: The size is right, but a nurture series needs a persona to speak to. Add one or more job titles.

missions.name: P3: Awareness
missions.brief: Brand wants broad top-of-funnel reach in the target market. Aim for 5,000 to 25,000 contacts using mainly firmographic criteria.
